description: Prompts the deterministic router misroutes today. Not counted as routing coverage. Each must keep reproducing its recorded misroute; when a routing fix makes one pass, tooling/routing_coverage.py --check fails until it is moved into suite.json.

cases.prompt: What should we build next in this repo before it goes to production? Lay it out as a roadmap.
cases.reason: No existing roadmap is mentioned and the user asks for one up to production, which is a whole-project baseline; product-operator's 'what should we build next' signal fires on its own and repo-to-roadmap has no signal for 'roadmap ... before production'
